description: PERMANENTLY delete a project and every resource in it (VMs, buckets, CDN deployments, DNS zones). Irreversible — only use when the user has clearly asked. Set confirm to true to execute.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete. Without it the call fails with a summary of what would be deleted.

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

name: edge_teardown_project
